```python
PARAMS = {
    "W_tail": (4.0, 1.0, 12.0),
    "W_in":   (4.0, 1.0, 12.0),
    "W_ln":   (2.0, 0.5, 6.0),
    "W_lp":   (2.0, 0.5, 6.0),
    "W_rst":  (1.0, 0.42, 3.0),
    "W_invn": (1.5, 0.42, 6.0),
    "W_invp": (3.0, 0.42, 12.0),
    "L":      (0.15, 0.15, 0.3),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    L = p["L"]
    vdd = 1.8
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-15)
    dv = spec.get("dv", 0.002)
    n = Netlist("vinp vinn clk outp outn vdd vss")

    # Tail switch, evaluates while clk is high
    n.M("Mt", "tail", "clk", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["W_tail"], L)
    # Input pair: xp is on the vinp side and discharges faster when vinp > vinn
    n.M("Min1", "xp", "vinp", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["W_in"], L)
    n.M("Min2", "xn", "vinn", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["W_in"], L)
    # Cross-coupled latch: lp sits above xp, ln above xn
    n.M("Mln1", "lp", "ln", "xp", "vss", "nfet", p["W_ln"], L)
    n.M("Mln2", "ln", "lp", "xn", "vss", "nfet", p["W_ln"], L)
    n.M("Mlp1", "lp", "ln", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_lp"], L)
    n.M("Mlp2", "ln", "lp", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_lp"], L)
    # Reset switches pull every internal node to VDD while clk is low
    for nm, nd in (("Mr1", "xp"), ("Mr2", "xn"), ("Mr3", "lp"), ("Mr4", "ln")):
        n.M(nm, nd, "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_rst"], L)
    # Output inverters: both outputs sit low during reset.
    # lp falls when vinp > vinn, so outp goes high.
    n.M("Mo1n", "outp", "lp", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["W_invn"], L)
    n.M("Mo1p", "outp", "lp", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_invp"], L)
    n.M("Mo2n", "outn", "ln", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["W_invn"], L)
    n.M("Mo2p", "outn", "ln", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_invp"], L)

    # ---- First-order predictions ----
    cg = 1.5e-15   # gate cap per um at minimum L (approximate)
    cj = 1.0e-15   # drain cap per um (approximate)
    C_x = cj * (p["W_in"] + p["W_ln"] + p["W_rst"])
    C_l = (cj * (p["W_ln"] + p["W_lp"] + p["W_rst"])
           + cg * (p["W_ln"] + p["W_lp"] + p["W_invn"] + p["W_invp"]))
    C_out = cl + cj * (p["W_invn"] + p["W_invp"])

    try:
        gmn = lut.op("n", p["W_ln"], L, 0.9, 0.9)["gm"]
        gmp = lut.op("p", p["W_lp"], L, 0.9, 0.9)["gm"]
        opi = lut.op("n", p["W_in"], L, 0.9, 0.6, 0.2)
        gmi, idi = opi["gm"], max(opi["Id"], 1e-6)
    except Exception:
        gmn, gmp = 2e-3 * p["W_ln"], 0.5e-3 * p["W_lp"]
        gmi, idi = 1e-3 * p["W_in"], 100e-6 * p["W_in"]

    # Integration: discharge C_x + C_l by about one nmos Vth
    t_int = (C_x + C_l) * 0.6 / idi
    av = max(gmi * t_int / max(C_l, 1e-16), 1.0)
    tau = C_l / max(gmn + gmp, 1e-6)
    t_reg = tau * math.log(max(vdd / (av * dv), 1.0))
    try:
        gmo = lut.op("n", p["W_invn"], L, 0.9, 0.9)["gm"]
    except Exception:
        gmo = 2e-3 * p["W_invn"]
    t_inv = 0.7 * C_out / max(gmo, 1e-6) * 1.5
    delay = t_int + t_reg + t_inv

    # Energy: all internal nodes recharge each cycle, plus one output edge
    energy = (2 * C_x + 2 * C_l + C_out + cg * p["W_tail"] * 0.5) * vdd ** 2

    return n, {"delay": delay, "energy": energy, "correct": 1}
```
